description: Find the gross salary on a comparison NBA team that matches the after-tax income of a known salary on a baseline team. Ask for the baseline team, comparison team, filing status, and either baseline_salary or base_salary. Do not invent team codes. Call list_tax_calculator_inputs for allowed values. Present the result as a calculation, not as tax or legal advice. Required before this call: baseline_team, comparison_team, and baseline_salary or base_salary. Match a player with list_team_players only after league, team, and season_id are known. Repeat inputs and defaults from the result in the reply. Results are income tax only unless the user asks for take-home: then send include_payroll_taxes, agent_fee_pct, retirement_contribution (401(k), or RRSP on a Canadian club) or rca_contribution (Canadian clubs), and report result.net_pay. Comparisons then match on net_pay.net_economic, which counts an RCA after its estimated payout tax (rca_payout_tax_rate; default 25% Canadian withholding on the US-duty-day share and the US federal marginal rate on the rest, or 25% on all of it for a US person).

agent_fee_pct.description: Agent fee as a percent of gross pay (0-10), treated as a non-deductible cost. Default 0.
agent_fee_pct.title: Agent Fee Pct

art_xvi4_inducement_sb.description: Opt in to Canada–U.S. Treaty Art. XVI(4) on an exempt signing bonus from a Canadian club.
art_xvi4_inducement_sb.title: Art Xvi4 Inducement Sb

base_salary.description: Duty-day base in whole dollars before signing and performance bonuses. Send this with the bonus fields to match Salary + Bonuses. Leave it out when sending baseline_salary.
base_salary.title: Base Salary

baseline_salary.description: One season total on the baseline team, taxed entirely as duty-day pay. Leave this out when sending base_salary.
baseline_salary.title: Baseline Salary

baseline_team.description: Team that pays the known salary.
baseline_team.title: Baseline Team

birth_country.description: Birth country code used with is_us_person.
birth_country.title: Birth Country

comparison_primary_domicile.description: Resident tax home modeled for the comparison team.
comparison_primary_domicile.title: Comparison Primary Domicile

comparison_team.description: Team whose gross pay is solved to match baseline after-tax income.
comparison_team.title: Comparison Team

estimated_playoff_games.description: Extra postseason games. Use 0 when there are none.
estimated_playoff_games.title: Estimated Playoff Games

exempt_signing_bonus_from_jock_tax.description: When true, the signing bonus is taxed in the player's domicile and left out of duty-day allocation.
exempt_signing_bonus_from_jock_tax.title: Exempt Signing Bonus From Jock Tax

filing_status.description: Single or Married_Joint. Defaults to Single when omitted.
filing_status.title: Filing Status

include_payroll_taxes.description: Opt in to employee payroll taxes for each team's employer: FICA (Social Security, Medicare, Additional Medicare) and the home state's disability or paid-leave levy for US clubs; CPP/QPP, EI and QPIP for Canadian clubs. Default false. For a Canadian resident it also applies the CPP/QPP and EI credits and the enhanced CPP/QPP deduction on the Canadian return. With any take-home option set, the match uses net_pay.net_economic and the response adds baseline_ and comparison_ net_pay, payroll_taxes, agent_fee and retirement_contribution.
include_payroll_taxes.title: Include Payroll Taxes

include_performance_bonus_in_jock_tax.description: When true, performance_bonus is part of the season total and of duty-day pay.
include_performance_bonus_in_jock_tax.title: Include Performance Bonus In Jock Tax

performance_bonus.description: Performance bonus in whole dollars. Included in the total only when include_performance_bonus_in_jock_tax is true.
performance_bonus.title: Performance Bonus

primary_domicile.description: Resident tax home: a state, a city, or a mode such as local_jurisdiction. Defaults to local_jurisdiction when omitted.
primary_domicile.title: Primary Domicile

rca_contribution.description: Salary deferred into a Retirement Compensation Arrangement by a Canadian club, in USD. Excluded from Canadian employment income until paid out: from worldwide income for a Canadian resident and in full from Canadian-source pay for a non-resident (Martin v. The King, 2024 TCC 153). US tax is unchanged. Not applied for US clubs. Comparisons count it after the estimated tax at payout (see rca_payout_tax_rate). Default 0.
rca_contribution.title: Rca Contribution

rca_payout_tax_rate.description: Estimated tax on the RCA when it is paid out, as a percent (0-100). Default models a player who retires to a no-tax US state and draws the RCA and its refundable tax account down at once: the US-duty-day share, already taxed by the US when contributed, bears Canada's 25% non-resident withholding, and the rest bears the US federal marginal rate on it (37% for a high earner). For a US person, who pays US tax on the whole contribution now, the default is the 25% withholding alone. Lowers net_pay.net_economic, which comparisons match on.
rca_payout_tax_rate.title: Rca Payout Tax Rate

retirement_catch_up.description: none (default), 50_plus (+$8,000) or 60_to_63 (+$11,250). Catch-up contributions are always Roth for athletes (prior-year FICA wages over $150,000).
retirement_catch_up.title: Retirement Catch Up

retirement_contribution.description: Annual retirement contribution in USD. On a US club it is a 401(k) elective deferral capped at the 2026 limit ($24,500 plus catch-up). On a Canadian club it is an RRSP contribution capped at C$33,810, deducted from Canadian taxable income only. Default 0.
retirement_contribution.title: Retirement Contribution

retirement_contribution_type.description: 401(k) only: pretax (default) lowers income-tax wages except in Pennsylvania, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Ohio cities, Kansas City and St. Louis; roth lowers nothing. RRSP contributions are always deductible.
retirement_contribution_type.title: Retirement Contribution Type

season_id.description: Schedule season as eight digits, such as 20252026. Defaults to the latest season for the league when omitted.
season_id.title: Season Id

signing_bonus.description: Signing bonus in whole dollars. The site adds this into the season total. On NFL it also includes other inducement pay.
signing_bonus.title: Signing Bonus

tolerance.description: Dollar tolerance for the equivalent-salary search. Defaults to 1.
tolerance.title: Tolerance

name: equivalent_nba_salary
title: Match NBA after-tax salary
